# Aunt Lavinia & Nell Harcourt

- [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) — Friend of — [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) — strong friendship formed between them · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P94](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0094)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) convinces [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) to let her stay at Isolde's and go to the [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert. After enjoying the concert and performances, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde return to the [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) home late at night, where they inadvertently jump into bed on top of Isolde's visiting [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P9](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P27](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P48](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0048)_

> After learning that [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) was furious over the bed-jumping incident and planned to leave, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) takes full responsibility for the prank. She goes into the parlor to apologize directly to [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md), successfully winning over the strict old woman with her honesty and charm. [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) decides to stay, forgives Isolde, and develops a fond friendship with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P60](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0060), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P79](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0079), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P83](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0083), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P92](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0092)_

> Isolde informs [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) of an invitation from [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) to visit her in town for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). After [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) consents, Mr. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) drives the girls to [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood), Aunt Lavinia's home, where [Miss Pembroke](../character/miss-pembroke.md) welcomes them warmly. The girls spend the week taking in the town's attractions, including attending the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) and a concert.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life
